boundaries.name: rust_representation_and_compiler
boundaries.obligation: Refine source u64/u32/u8/u16 values, fixed arrays, shift/OR, bounds panics, allocation, Serde camelCase and thiserror string construction to native compiler behavior. NativeWidths represents valid native field storage, not circuit acceptance.

boundaries.name: close_intent_constructor
boundaries.obligation: NewIntent must be actual CloseIntent::new with complete State/Withdrawal identity, including source fields retained opaquely here; prove its own checks separately. This module only proves error propagation and exact full-intent equality before projection.

boundaries.name: hash_and_word_bytes
boundaries.obligation: HashWords must implement native hash_words/Keccak over four-byte big-endian canonical u32 words. IMCS and all 92 IMTF words are represented, but hash collision/preimage resistance and compiled byte equivalence are not proved.

boundaries.name: circuit_and_solidity_bridge
boundaries.obligation: Native 103-field order was compared with CloseCircuit.PublicInputs.words and SettlementVerifier.closeLayout and matches; construct and prove cross-module canonical type/word-byte conversions before treating this as a compiler-to-circuit-to-L1 theorem. Native zero placeholder memberSet is later authenticated by circuit member proof, while Solidity also checks protocol count/token bounds and recomputed IMCS/TFD.
